tools.name: avalanche_coverage
tools.description: Is there an avalanche report at all right now, and in which regions? Lists every warning region in the Alps with a current report, grouped by warning service, with validity. Off season most regions have none. Contains no danger levels: use avalanche_bulletin for those.

tools.name: avalanche_region
tools.description: Does a summit, destination or point lie in an avalanche warning region of the Alps, in which one, and does it have a current report? Takes the name of a place or of a region, or up to 20 points such as start and summit of a tour. Also names other regions within 2 km.

tools.name: avalanche_overview
tools.description: How is the avalanche situation in a wider area of the Alps, such as Tyrol or the Valais? Give the name of a place or warning region, or lat and lon, with an optional radius, or a warning service. Returns every report for the area with its danger levels per elevation, avalanche problems and main mess

tools.name: avalanche_bulletin
tools.description: The danger level where someone is going in the Alps, from the official avalanche bulletin: give a place name or the name of a warning region, or lat and lon, or a region id. The elevation of a named place or point is looked up unless you give elevationM. atPlace holds the level for that elevation an
